title: Road feel and soft suspension
summary: Feedback on road feel and drive characteristics is sparse and mostly undetermined, with one positive comment about flat, road-tracking behavior alongside ambiguous remarks about shaking, soft suspension, and unspecified driving characteristics.

positive.summary: The positive review praises high body rigidity for giving a flat driving feel and clear tracking of the road surface.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention road-surface-dependent shaking, a soft suspension that still follows the road well, and one too-vague reference to driving characteristics to classify clearly.

limitations: Most sampled feedback is undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
One fragment is too vague to identify a specific aspect beyond general driving characteristics.
The topic clusters related but loosely specified ideas about road surface response, suspension softness, and overall driving feel, so coherence is limited.
